title.narrative: Fiscal Management Enhancement Project for the State of Pernambuco PROFISCO II-PE
Proyecto de Mejora de la Gestin Fiscal del Estado de Pernambuco PROFISCO II-PE

description.narrative: El objetivo del proyecto es contribuir a la sostenibilidad fiscal del Estado a travs de:(i) la modernizacin de la gestin hacendaria; (ii) la mejora de la administracin tributaria; y (iii) la mejora de la gestin delgasto pblico.El presente proyecto es la quinta operacin individual de prstamo bajo la CCLIP PROFISCO II (BR-X1039), aprobadapor el Directorio Ejecutivo mediante Resolucin DE-11317.

The project objective is to contribute to the State's fiscal sustainability through: (i) modernization of fiscal management;(ii) improvement of tax administration; and (iii) improvement of public expenditure management. This project is the fifth individualloan operation under the PROFISCO II CCLIP (BR-X1039) approved by the Board of Executive Directors through Resolution DE-11317.
